messages.subject: histogram ggplot2
parts:
Hello All,

I am trying to get a histogram of a Treatment tiers across PAS scores that has 12 levels and also have percentages on top of each bar.
The code below works but percentages are relative to observations in the whole data set instead of by total in level, I would want it relative to the total in each level, so that percentages on bars in each
level will add up to 100.  In this code below percentages in each cell do not add up to a 100, I would have to add all percentages across PAS scores to get a 100.

Can someone please help.


ggplot(dat,aes(as.factor(Treatment.Tiers),y=..count..,label=scales::percent(..count../sum(..count..))))+
eom_histogram(fill="lightyellow",colour="darkblue",binwidth=4)+facet_wrap(~PAS.score, nrow=4)+geom_text(stat="bin",size=3)+
xlab("Treatment Tiers")+opts(title=expression("Histogram of Treatment Tiers across PAS scores"))

Wateva
